decision: The competitor (Visa Cash App Racing Bulls F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: Car 6 was released into the path of Car 1 in the pit lane.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 6 (Isack Hadjar), the driver of Car 1 (Max Verstappen), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence and determine as follows. The driver of Car 6 stated that he followed the instructions of his pit lane representative ('the Number 1') and came out of the garage when requested to do so. He was slightly late in exiting the garage but in any event it was clear that the release was late and that resulted in Car 6 being released into the path of Car 1. The driver of Car 1 had to take evasive action to avoid a collision or risk flat spotting his tyres if he braked hard. The team representative accepted that the team made a mistake in this instance. We accordingly imposed a fine of €5,000 to the team.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
